question.text: Rebalancing VIA INFLOWS is tax-efficient because:

answer.text: Uses new cash to buy underweight positions, avoiding sales and capital gains tax

explanation.text: The Logic: Adds new money to underweight sleeves instead of selling overweight — defers capital gains tax. The Trap: Regulators don't forbid it; this is best practice. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B Topic 21. Manager's Pro-Tip: Build inflow-rebalancing into contribution schedules — automates tax efficiency.
